$Comment: A costume: for three minutes the wearer takes the Lost Soul's look (the model Hallows_Eve_Lost_Soul). It changes the model and is no debuff, which is what makes it a costume: the wearer can take it off any time with /zigcostume off, and no second costume goes over it. The Costume Wand's secondary use and the trick-or-treat tricks put it on. Duration is in seconds.
Name: hallowseve.items.effect.hallows_eve_costume_lost_soul.name
